TAGLINE: IIM Sirmaur MBA and Bar Certified Advocate bridging courtroom litigation with corporate regulatory compliance
SUMMARY: IIM Sirmaur MBA graduate and practicing advocate with continuous High Court litigation experience at Gandhi & Co. covering commercial contracts, statutory disputes, and regulatory filings. Cleared Rajasthan Judicial Services Preliminary Examination (2024) and All India Bar Examination (2021). Top 98.66% in International Mathematics Olympiad. Brings rigorous legal research, analytical precision, and multi stakeholder governance across corporate disputes and transactions, vendor contracts, and statutory registrations. Combines legal precision with business acumen to drive compliance governance, contract review, and regulatory risk management.
WHY_I_FIT:
Corporate compliance teams need someone who understands both the letter of the law and the commercial consequences of non compliance. At **Gandhi & Co.**, I spent four years managing 50+ active dispute briefs with 90% concentration before the **High Court**, which means I know how regulatory failures actually play out in enforcement proceedings, not just in policy documents.

I have drafted **15+ commercial agreements** and statutory pleadings under the Indian Contract Act and the Negotiable Instruments Act, attended **100+ court hearings**, and managed **30+ client consultations** on dispute resolution strategy. My MBA from **IIM Sirmaur** adds the commercial lens: I can evaluate compliance risk in the context of balance sheet exposure, not just statutory obligation.

I cleared the **Rajasthan Judicial Services Preliminary Examination** in 2024, demonstrating section level mastery across CPC, CrPC, IPC, Contract Act, NI Act, and Rent Control statutes. I also built and exited **Naraina Jewellers**, where I personally handled GST registration, trade licensing, vendor contract structuring, and statutory filings for a retail business.

This combination of courtroom enforcement experience, deep statutory knowledge, commercial business judgment, and hands on regulatory filing experience is exactly what corporate compliance functions need.
